request.system: You draft short notes from Hartwell's HR function to its CFO. Use only numbers that appear in the calculator output you are given; do not compute new ones. House rule: report time freed in hours and FTE-equivalents of time, never as heads removed. Say which figures are claims not yet measured. Plain prose, under 170 words, no headings, no bullet points.

messages.content:
From the CFO: I need HR's AI case in cost per head. How many heads does this take out, and when?

Calculator output:
TALENT TO VALUE (synthetic, USD)
roles scored 48; critical 40
incumbents in critical roles 606
expected vacancy cost, critical roles $22,939,001 a year
role      per day   days      a year  crit
FT-US          84 74,958   6,273,882  no
PD-US       3,342    598   2,000,132  yes
FT-UK          98 19,890   1,959,029  no
RS-CA       1,666    950   1,583,783  yes
GM-US       1,909    804   1,534,296  yes
BMS-US      1,358  1,008   1,368,395  yes
CE-US       1,889    642   1,213,142  yes
HV-UK       2,040    558   1,138,167  yes
fill PD-US 30 days sooner: $352,964 a year

COST PER RESOLVED CONTACT (synthetic, USD)
model                       seat   naive  all-in
Denver shared services   116,680   35.38   52.35
Hyderabad center          34,710   10.87   23.96
Meridian BPO              29,808   11.50   25.05

AGENT AT TIER 0 (status: Claimed)
containment 60%: $13.92 per query
containment 40%: $19.83 per query
containment 20%: $25.74 per query
break-even containment 22.3%

HOURS, NOT HEADS
hours freed 103,200; placed 103,200
FTE-equivalent of time 60.0
hours measured so far 0
  30,000  Pipelines and succession for the 40 roles
  24,000  Agent supervision and the human route
  18,000  Manager coaching and case backlog
  16,000  Skills inventory (objective 4)
  15,200  Agent-platform operations, Hyderabad
decision-rights problems: 0

content.text:
The calculator doesn't support a headcount figure, so I've reported time instead. It shows 103,200 hours freed, equal to 60.0 FTE-equivalents of time, placed into succession, agent supervision, manager coaching, skills inventory, and Hyderabad platform operations. Hours measured so far is zero, so treat every hours figure as a claim. The Tier 0 agent is also still Claimed. It breaks even at 22.3% containment, and cost per query runs from $13.92 at 60% containment to $25.74 at 20%.

No cost-per-head figure appears in the output. The closest comparison is cost per resolved contact, all-in: $23.96 in Hyderabad, $25.05 at Meridian, and $52.35 in Denver.

The output gives no dates, so I can't say when any of this lands. The one benefit dollar figure is $352,964 a year from filling PD-US 30 days sooner, against $22,939,001 a year in expected vacancy cost for critical roles. Decision-rights problems are reported as zero.
